name: Tangram City
description: Drag, turn and flip the seven tangram pieces to fill city shapes, then count area and perimeter.

about.concept: Geometry by hand. Seven pieces fill a shape only when turned and flipped the right way; the child learns rotation, reflection, how shapes compose, and then counts area and perimeter on what was built.
about.progression: Outlined pieces show where each one goes. Later shapes show only the silhouette, then rotated silhouettes, then measurement questions about the finished figure.
